query: No survey, no register, nothing for this tenant's flat. Housing officer says just get on with the bathroom. Can we start?
These flats were built in 2003. Do we still have to bother about asbestos before we drill?
Lad drilled through a panel under a window before checking, there's dust on his sleeves and on the floor, tenant's in the next room. What do I do right now?
Can my plumbers take off the old lagging on the pipes in the airing cupboard if they're careful and wear masks?
Taking out a small AIB partition in a flat as part of the refurb. Reckon it's about an hour and a half total with two men. What category is that?
How do I notify NNLW and how much notice do I have to give?
Two of my lads will be doing notifiable work for the first time. What medicals do they need, who does them, and how often?
The NNLW medical has to be done by one of HSE's own doctors, doesn't it?
What records do I have to keep for the lads doing NNLW, and for how long?
My plasterers and electricians won't be touching asbestos on purpose. Do they still need asbestos training?
How should we bag and store the asbestos waste from a non-licensed job until it goes to the tip?
Full strip-out of a block of flats. Client wants us to start the joinery while the asbestos removers work alongside us. Allowed?
We're getting a licensed contractor in to strip lagging in the plant room. How much notice do they have to give HSE?
Our scaffolders are putting up the scaffold for the licensed firm to take off AIB soffits. Do the scaffolders need to be licensed too?
After the licensed removal in the flat, who signs it off as safe for the tenant to move back, and how does that work?
The removal firm says they'll bring their own analyst for the clearance. Is that OK now, and what's changing in 2027?
I heard the asbestos rules change on 25 November this year and the removers can't choose their own analyst from next week. Is that right?
Who's responsible for managing asbestos in the stairwells and roof space of the council block, and does that cover inside the flats?
Housing association says the duty to manage doesn't cover inside the flats, so we're on our own for asbestos info. Does that mean we don't have to check anything inside?
What's the actual exposure limit for asbestos? I've seen 0.1 and 0.6 mentioned.
The refurb has loads of little AIB bits: a panel here, a soffit there, a cupboard lining. Can I treat each one as its own short job so none of it is notifiable?
I've got an electrician from another firm and the tenant in the flat while we do a non-licensed job. What do I owe them?
Our self-employed plasterer says the asbestos rules are for employers, not him. True?
Old fire door in the flat has AIB inside it. Can we take the door off and skip it ourselves?
Customer wants their old combi swapped for a new one. My gas engineer is Gas Safe. Do I still have to tell building control or pay for an inspection?
Bathroom refit, same layout, we're just ripping out the old suite and putting a new bath, toilet and basin back in the same spots. Is that notifiable?
Homeowner wants a shower room put into a box bedroom upstairs where there's no plumbing at the moment. Do I need building regs sign-off, and can my plumber self-certify it?
My window fitter isn't FENSA or anything. Can he still do a full house of replacement windows, and how do we get it signed off?
We're hacking off all the old plaster on the back wall of a solid brick terrace and re-plastering. Someone said that triggers having to insulate it. True?
Replacing the felt on a flat roof garage extension with a new rubber membrane. Does that need building control, and do I have to add insulation?
Which glass needs to be toughened or laminated? Fitting a glazed back door with side panels and a low window next to it.
Customer wants a kitchen extension right over the line of the public sewer at the back. Building notice ok, or do I need something else first?
Just put a new gas boiler in the kitchen. Do I have to fit a CO alarm and where does it go?
We're fitting a wood burner into an existing fireplace in a lounge. What do I need: who signs it off, alarm, any label?
Kitchen refit, the sparky's adding a few sockets off the existing ring and a new radial for the oven. Which bits are notifiable?
Building notice or full plans for a single storey extension? What's the real difference?
Plans are passed. How much notice do I give building control before we dig, and what's this 'commencement' notice after we start?
Bought a house to do up and the loft was converted by the last owner with no paperwork. Can we get it signed off now?
Big loft job: client hired their own architect, a separate steel fabricator and us as main builder, but never appointed anyone in writing as principal designer or contractor. Who is it by default?
What actually changes with the Future Homes Standard in 2026/27 for a firm like mine doing extensions, windows and boilers?
Put a building notice in February 2027 for an extension but the client wants to wait and start in spring 2028. Old Part L or new?
Client wants a downstairs toilet straight off the kitchen. Do I need a lobby between them?
Loft conversion with a new bedroom and shower room. Does building control care about sound between the new rooms and the floor below?
Loft conversion in a terrace. We need to pocket the steel beam into the party wall. What notice do I give the neighbour and how long before?
Rear extension footings will be about 2 m from the neighbour's back wall and deeper than their foundations. Party wall notice needed even if I'm not touching their wall?
Served party wall notice three weeks ago, neighbour hasn't replied at all. Can I just crack on?
Small conservatory at the back, about 12 square metres, on a dwarf wall. Building regs or exempt?
Garden office/summerhouse, about 20 square metres, timber, half a metre off the fence, with power run from the house. Does it need building regs?
Taking out a chimney breast in a back bedroom on a terrace. Building control? Neighbour?
Customer's asking for the boiler compliance certificate. How long has the installer got to send it?
Bathroom refit in a normal house, new bath going in. Do regs make me fit a TMV to stop the bath going over 48 degrees?
Client says the new rear extension has to have a level threshold and wheelchair-width doors because of Part M. Is that right?
Replacing windows on an old house. Do they all have to be PAS 24 security rated now because of Part Q?
Since Part T came in, does a new downstairs loo in a house have to be a universal toilet?
Do I now have to put an EV charger in when I build a house extension with a driveway?
Combustible cladding ban: does that mean I can't put timber cladding on a two storey house extension?
Building control will want an overheating assessment for our loft conversion with big rooflights, under Part O?
Do I need building control for this job?
Do I need to serve a party wall notice?
Who's meant to check the fire doors in our 14-storey council block, and how often?
Tenant on the 6th floor keeps refusing to let us in to check her front door closer. Is the council in breach?
What's the proper way to test a closer on a fire door so I know it's actually working?
The Fire Safety England Regs mean every flat front door now has to meet today's certified standard, so we should quote to replace the lot, yeah?
Our block's only 4 storeys, top floor about 9m up. We need to start doing the quarterly door checks as well, right?
What does the council legally have to tell residents about fire doors?
Are flat front doors the council's job under fire safety law, or are they the tenant's own business?
As the council's repairs contractor, do we carry any legal duties under the Fire Safety Order, or is it all on the council?
Council tenant's flat, what smoke alarms does the landlord legally have to have in there?
There's a gas hob in the kitchen so the landlord has to put a CO alarm in there, right?
Tenant rang saying her smoke alarm keeps chirping. What does the council actually have to do?
The council's a social landlord, so the smoke and CO alarm rules don't apply to their flats anyway?
Same block, but one flat's a leaseholder who bought from the council. Do the alarm regs cover his flat?
In our 20-storey block, what has to be checked every month, and what if the firefighting lift goes down?
Does the block need one of those secure information boxes for the fire brigade, and what's supposed to go in it?
Block's 8 storeys but only about 17m to the top floor. Is it higher-risk or not?
Block has a basement car park, 6 floors of flats above it and a roof garden on top. Is that 7 storeys?
Two 8-storey council towers joined by a shared underground car park. Is that one higher-risk building or two?
Fire stopping and communal door upgrades across a registered high-rise as part of a remediation job. Do we need BSR sign-off first, and how long does it take?
Water leak has wrecked the fire stopping in a riser in a higher-risk block and it needs sorting today. Do we have to wait for BSR?
The fire service has served an enforcement notice on the tower, so that counts as emergency repairs and we can skip BSR approval, yes?
Residents in the tower keep wedging the stair doors open and pulling smoke detectors off the ceiling. Is there any law aimed at the residents themselves?
Once we've finished a full refurb of the common parts, does the council's fire risk assessment need redoing?
What info does the council have to give residents about fire safety in the block generally?
We've done a big refurb of the common parts in a council block, a material alteration. Do we now have to hand over the reg 38 fire info pack?
How often do the fire doors need checking?
New Awaab's Law job just came in. Can you run me through every deadline we're up against from the minute the tenant rings?
Emergency hazard on an Awaab job, say water pouring through a ceiling. How fast do we have to get there and finish, and when does the clock actually start?
What actually makes damp and mould 'significant' under Awaab's Law, compared with a bit of mould we'd just stick on the normal repairs list?
Tenant reported damp late on a Friday. Does the Saturday count towards the 10 days for the investigation, and which day is day one?
What has to go in the written summary we send the tenant after an inspection, and how long do we get to send it?
We went out the same day to a burst waste pipe, replaced it and cleaned up, all done. Do we still have to send the tenant a written summary?
We assessed a mould report off the tenant's photos and said it wasn't serious. Now she wants someone to physically come round. Do we have to, and by when?
Inspection found the damp's coming through a damaged roof that needs scaffold, and we can't get scaffolders for about a month. Are we breaking Awaab's Law?
If we can't make a significant hazard safe inside the 5 working days, what are we on the hook for with the family?
Tenant won't move into the hotel we found while we fix a dangerous ceiling. Can she just stay put, and what do we owe her then?
When we rehouse someone under Awaab's Law, do we have to include her son who only stays over at weekends?
Tenant keeps cancelling our damp survey. How much notice do we need to give to get in, and are we in trouble if we blow the 10 days?
Does whoever does our Awaab's Law inspections need to be an HHSRS-trained surveyor?
Found the tenant had taped over the bathroom extractor and the mould's back. Does Awaab's Law still apply to that one?
Heating in the block runs off a district system the freeholder looks after and it's gone down. Is that an Awaab job for the housing association?
Fire door on a shared landing in our tower block is smashed. Do we log it as an Awaab's Law job?
Tenant with a toddler has a smashed socket with live bits showing. What's our timescale and who should we send?
When does Awaab's Law pick up the rest of the HHSRS hazards, things like noise or keeping burglars out?
We're looking at a fire risk in a block with dodgy cladding. Is replacing the cladding Awaab work with the 5-day deadline?
We do repairs for a housing association with general needs flats, some shared ownership, and supported housing where people are on licences. Which of those does Awaab's Law cover?
What makes something an HHSRS category 1 hazard rather than category 2?
Our surveyors are still working off the old 29-hazard HHSRS list. Has that changed?
How often do the electrics need testing in our social housing, and is there a catch-up deadline for tenants who were already in?
Void re-let next week. The EICR's three years old and the next-due date hasn't passed. Do we need a fresh one before the new tenant moves in?
What does the landlord's basic repairing duty under section 11 actually cover?
Tenant's own washing machine flooded the kitchen. Do we have to repair the machine, and is any of it an Awaab job?
Tenant's solicitor reckons the flat isn't fit to live in. What will a court actually look at?
My supervisor says under Awaab's Law we get 14 calendar days to go out and investigate a damp report. Is that right?
Flat's badly overcrowded and there's mould everywhere. Overcrowding isn't covered by Awaab's Law, so we can leave the mould to normal repairs?
Tried to verify a plasterer, he gave me his UTR but under his trading name and HMRC came back unmatched. What rate do I use and what goes on his statement?
We last used a bricklayer in March 2024 and want him back now. Surely I don't have to verify him again, he's been on our books before?
Groundworker we paid gross in July 2025 is back on site. Do I need to re-verify, and do I keep paying him gross?
Our sister company in our group used this electrician last year. Can we pay him without verifying ourselves?
Can I verify a sub with HMRC before we've agreed anything, just to know his deduction rate while I'm pricing the job?
For the tax month ending 5 December, when does the CIS return have to reach HMRC and when do I have to pay the deductions over if I pay by bank transfer?
We missed taking CIS off one sub for three months, honest mistake. HMRC say we owe the 20% ourselves. Is there any way out of paying it?
We're a company with two directors and want gross payment status. What turnover do we need to show?
HMRC letter says we're failing the annual gross status review. How long have we got, can we appeal, and if we lose it when can we reapply?
Heard that since April 2026 HMRC can make us pay if some sub-sub further down our chain dodges CIS or PAYE. Is that right, and how bad can it get?
What actually changed in CIS from 6 April 2026? Give me the list for the office.
We've paid the county council's highways team to do the road crossing into our site. I need to verify them and take 20% like any other sub, yes?
Our client is a property investment company, not a builder, but it's spent about £3.5m on refurbs this year on flats it lets out. Should they be taking CIS off our payments?
Our roofer has gross payment status, so there's no reverse charge on his invoices, right?
Housing association client says they're an 'end user' so we should charge them normal VAT. What do we need from them before we stop reverse charging?
Job is mostly fitting CCTV and alarms, but our sub also digs the trenches and puts in the concrete posts. Reverse charge or not?
Our sub-contract has no payment terms written in at all. When do interim payments fall due and when is the final date to pay?
We want to pay a sub less than his application because of defects. Contract doesn't say anything about pay less notices. What's my deadline?
The main contractor never sent a payment notice within 5 days of the due date and now isn't paying us. What can we do?
Our sub-contract says we only pay the sub once the client pays us. Client hasn't paid, so we don't have to pay the sub yet, correct?
Main contractor is way past the final date and hasn't paid. Can we down tools, and what notice do we have to give?
If we go to adjudication over an unpaid valuation, how long does it all take?
The job was only four weeks long, so the sub can't take us to adjudication, can he?
District council job, estimated £180k of works. Their tender pack wants three years of audited accounts and a pre-qualification questionnaire before we can even bid. Are they allowed to do that?
Council's got a £25k repair job. Will it show up on Find a Tender, or do they just ring round?
Can our local council keep a small works tender just for local firms? We'd love that.
Thresholds changed in January 2026, but the council published the tender notice for our job in December 2025. Which thresholds apply?
Is this invoice meant to be reverse charge or not?
When have I got to pay my sub?
We're building a kitchen extension for a homeowner and it's only my firm on the job. Who counts as the client under CDM, and do I end up doing the client's bits?
Homeowner job, we're the main builder but the client has booked their own sparky directly. Does that change anything about who is principal contractor?
Loft conversion, about six weeks with four of my lads on it. Do I need to send HSE an F10?
On a big domestic job that does need notifying, is it the homeowner who sends the F10 or me? And do I have to stick it up somewhere?
One week bathroom refit for a homeowner. Do I honestly need a written phase plan for that?
The homeowner's architect says they want to run the whole project and carry the client responsibilities rather than us. Is that allowed?
A housing association has hired us to refurb some of their flats. They're people's homes, so the client duties fall on us like on a homeowner job, right?
The job isn't notifiable, so CDM doesn't really apply to it, does it?
What should a site induction cover for new lads starting with us on a job?
One of my Romanian lads asked if he can say no to going up on a scaffold he thinks is dodgy. Where does he stand?
What welfare do I need on a small domestic site? Toilets, washing, the lot.
Can we just use the homeowner's loo and kitchen instead of getting a welfare unit in?
Several subbies on site this month. Whose job is the welfare, mine as main contractor or each of theirs?
How many toilets do I need?
Painting soffits and fascias on a two-storey semi, probably two days' work. Ladder or tower?
Someone told me ladders are banned on building sites now. Is that true?
What angle should a ladder be at, how far does it need to stick out above the landing, and is footing it good enough?
Is this ladder OK to use?
We keep shifting the aluminium tower round the room every hour or so. Does it need a fresh inspection every time we move it?
Customer's garage has an old corrugated cement sheet roof. My lad wants to walk across it to sort the gutter. OK?
If a lad on a harness falls and is left hanging, do I really need my own rescue plan? Can't we just call 999?
Cutting concrete blocks with a disc cutter today. What does the law expect me to do about the dust?
Do my lads' dust masks need face-fit testing? One of them has a big beard and won't shave it.
We've got a dust extraction unit in the workshop. How often does it need a proper check and how long do I keep the paperwork?
My lads are on the breaker and kango for hours. What are the vibration limits?
At what noise level do I have to give the lads ear defenders, and when do they have to wear them?
I haven't got a noise meter. How do I know if I need to do a noise assessment?
I'll just buy the ear defenders with the highest rating, the more they block the better.
First aid on a site with about 15 of us: what kit do I need and how many first aiders?
Digger arm touched the overhead line at the back of the site. Nobody hurt, thank God. Do I need to tell anyone, and how far should we have stayed away?
Before we dig the footings, what do I have to do about buried cables and gas pipes?
The customer's electrician says that circuit's switched off. Can my lad just crack on and chase the wall?
When is anyone allowed to work on live electrics?
My plumber does a bit of gas work on our jobs. Does he have to be Gas Safe, and is it on me to check?
Customer wants the new gas boiler put in the en-suite. Any rule against that?
Is my plumber allowed to do this gas job?
Do I need a written health and safety policy now we've got 15 on the books?
A few of my lads are paid self-employed through CIS. Am I still responsible for their safety on site?
Taking on a 17-year-old apprentice next month. Anything extra I need to do?
What training do my workers actually need for CDM? Do they all need cards and courses?
We've got a 1.5 m trench with trench boxes in. Who has to inspect it and how often?
Do I need to notify this job?
